We propose a novel framework SgSum which transforms the MDS task into the problem of sub-graph selection. SgSum captures the relations between sentences by modelling both the graph structure of the whole document set and the candidate subgraphs, then directly output an integrate summary in the form of sub-graph which is more informative and coherent.
outputs: extractive summaries in the form of sub-graphs
Extractive multi‑document summaries (sets of sentences selected from the source documents)

guideline: Annotators assess the overall quality of summaries by ranking them considering the following criteria: (1) Informativeness: is the main meaning expressed in the source documents preserved in the summary? (2) Coherence: is the summary coherent between sentences and well-formed?
Annotators rank each system summary from 1 (best) to 4 (worst) based on informativeness and coherence, and scores are averaged to obtain ratings.
